raw_capture_metadata_only.method: Memory-mapped full binary raw; every original vector retained; no interpolation/decimation

actual_scalar_findings.limits_of_correlation: Failure of the same two C/D stages and low selector headroom is consistent with a stage problem, but neither scalar extrema nor stage membership establishes that headroom caused sample errors, phase deficit or VI deficit. A/B samplers and both comparators also fail their original gates.

bias_and_load_source.external_fixture: Original10ohm data/clock source resistors;150fF at eight actual sampler data-pair collector references;50fF comparator output loads; nominal clock1.29V common mode +/-0.15V before physical loading.
bias_and_load_source.gain_load: Native8um/1.8um rppd from AVDD to LP/LN and native4um/5um rppd from LP/LN to AVSS; LP/LN feed upper master data bases.
bias_and_load_source.gain_tail: Two53.335um/0.3um MOS per input gain; actual sum minima4.235055448mA D and3.805070553mA C.
bias_and_load_source.master_tail: Four physical36um/0.3um MOS devices share each master drain; actual instantaneous sum minima are3.391972853mA for D and3.340038673mA for C, above unchanged0.5mA gate.
bias_and_load_source.selector_collector_bleed: Separate1um/38.4um M_BS shunt joins upper data emitters and selector collectors to AVSS. It is not the4um input shunt proposed below.
bias_and_load_source.shared_reference: Each affected sampler retains one diode-connected8um/0.3um MOS XREF (D native11, C native40) driven by the original0.5mA bias; gain and both latch tails share this reference. No ideal current-ratio inference is used.

conclusion: Exact four-device roles and current source connections are established. Low VCE and independent functional rejections are established; root cause and benefit of the four-shunt candidate are not established.

missing_discriminating_measurements.RC: Use exact fresh model source435f4742 and the actual extracted wire R/C records to locate passive path drops/delays. Scalar report has no coincident transient path currents or effective time constants. Compact self-heated rppd current is not available merely from terminal extrema; no complete KCL is asserted.
decomposition: VCE(selector) = [Vb(upper)-Vb(selector)] - VBE(upper) + VBE(selector) - [Ve(upper)-Vc(selector)] for each actual upper-master path.
VCE(selector) = Vc(selector)-Vd(tail MOS) - [Ve(selector)-Vd(tail MOS)] at the same row; the last term exposes remaining emitter-to-tail transport drop.
Measure gain-collector-to-master-base wire drop, LP/LN common mode/differential, local cn/cp attenuation/skew, local AVDD/AVSS drops, and master/slave outputs simultaneously.

Preserve full failed traces/results. No such experiment is launched or authorized here.
missing_discriminating_measurements.requested_device_currents: Existing saved native collector currents for gain/upper/selector HBTs and drain currents for gain/master/slave tail MOS groups at the same rows; do not equate Ic to Ie.
missing_discriminating_measurements.same_capture_first: A separately authorized cloud-only numerical readback of this exact saved nominal_late capture can localize the deficit before any circuit edit or new simulation.

Original prescribed C/D wrong-sign sample rows and each sampler/comparator worst-delay window, retaining the original masks/edge references and A/B controls.

native_identifier_permutation.warning: Anonymous extracted net names and cluster integers are current-capture identities, not stable schematic names. Do not reuse old $698/cluster134 for the C master selector collector.

one_bounded_candidate.name: Restore only C/D active-input gain pull-down length to the prior7.4um source value
one_bounded_candidate.no_chosen_resistor_current_or_RC_value: No compact rppd current is inferred from L/W or extrema; exact model/temperature/loading and same-row measurements are missing.
one_bounded_candidate.not_a_global_fix_claim: This scope directly addresses one headroom hypothesis in C/D; it is not shown to cure A/B timing/margins, comparator signs,30mV phase average or50uA VI output.
one_bounded_candidate.only_proposed_dimension_change: Four native rppd lengths5.0→7.4um at fixed width4um; these are exactly the prior v59 cd_shunt target set184/185/222/223.
one_bounded_candidate.preserve: All124HBT and50MOS sizes/counts/biases, original clock/data sources and phases, all150fF/50fF loads, seven MIMs, current tail-bus additions, unrelated material and every original numerical acceptance predicate.
one_bounded_candidate.rationale: A weaker pull-down tends to raise the loaded LP/LN common mode. The exact topology carries LP/LN through master input HBT base-to-emitter voltage to the failing selector collectors. Raising those collector voltages can increase selector VCE at unchanged clock drive; this is a circuit-direction hypothesis, not an extracted-model improvement calculation.
tradeoffs: Higher input common mode reduces upper master input HBT VCE and may reduce gain-HBT headroom; all device screens must remain enforced.
The increased shunt resistance changes the loaded RC and differential gain. It may worsen settling despite improved static headroom; sampler37.5ps and comparator75ps remain unchanged.

Restoring an old resistor dimension inside the current additive-tail layout is a new physical candidate; old standalone geometry or RC cannot qualify it. Native ownership/DRC/LVS/terminal binding and both original numerical RC orders must be fresh.

original_gates.MOS: All50: original five absolute terminal differences <=1.32V and minimum activeVDS>=0; all individual tail current minima nonnegative; all16 instantaneous physical stage sums>=0.5mA.
original_gates.comparator: 765 signed samples at phases0.6/0.75/0.9UI; margin>=100mV and actual original delay<=0.6UI=75ps.
original_gates.delay_definition: Last native row with signed differential<100mV in the prescribed edge..edge+0.95UI window, plus originalSTEP; not a fitted crossing and not measured-output rephasing.
original_gates.sampler: 765 signed samples per sampler at phases0.3/0.6/0.9UI; margin>=100mV and actual original delay<=0.3UI=37.5ps.
original_gates.source_timing_correction: The explanatory62.5ps in the root scalar-breakdown action is not this worker predicate.62.5ps belongs to the distinct PLL first-fall gate; this analysis preserves source-exact37.5ps/75ps.

.subckt nssoc_rx_sampler_active_input_v57 dp dn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub iref
XREF iref iref avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=8u l=.3u ng=1
* Active input replaces all four passive divider resistors.
* Gain gates share the one existing8um XREF; no duplicate bias source.
XGP ln dp gain_tail sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XGN lp dn gain_tail sub npn13G2 Nx=4
XGT0 gain_tail iref avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=53.335u l=.3u ng=1
XGT1 gain_tail iref avss sub sg13_lv_nmos w=53.335u l=.3u ng=1
XUP avdd lp sub rppd w=8u l=1.8u b=0 sw_et=1
XUN avdd ln sub rppd w=8u l=1.8u b=0 sw_et=1
XDP lp avss sub rppd w=4u l=7.4u b=0 sw_et=1
XDN ln avss sub rppd w=4u l=7.4u b=0 sw_et=1
* Master tracks low clock; slave tracks high clock, capturing a rising edge.
XM lp ln mp mn clkn clkp avdd avss sub iref nssoc_cml_latch_settling_v32
XS mp mn qp qn clkp clkn avdd avss sub iref nssoc_cml_slave_settling_v32
.ends nssoc_rx_sampler_active_input_v57
